status: R1 ratchet plus R2 classification for offers, interviews and the task/template operational routes.
rule: live_mutations - classified MUST NOT exceed baseline_unclassified. Adding a mutation route therefore fails the contract test until it is classified or this baseline is raised in review.

classified.response: offer view with offer_id, candidate_id, project_id, status
classified.concurrency: none - create-only, no If-Match or expected revision
classified.human_actor: yes - actor defaults to human; the offer is never created by AI
classified.invariants: candidate must exist (404) and be in interview or offer stage (409 invariant_conflict)
classified.side_effects: creates one OfferRecord row plus one audit event in the same transaction

classified.response: offer view with the new status
classified.concurrency: none observed - no If-Match/expected revision, so two clients race last-write-wins. Recorded as a gap, not a guarantee.
classified.audit: OFFER_STATUS_CHANGED with from/to status and candidate_id
classified.invariants: status must be a known OFFER_STATES value and must follow the allowed transition table (409 invariant_conflict)
classified.side_effects: mutates OfferRecord.status plus one audit event in the same transaction

classified.request: event_type (required), title, notes, source_id, metadata{questions,feedback}, scheduled_at, duration_minutes, interviewer, location, event_state, outcome, actor
classified.concurrency: none - create-only, no If-Match or expected revision
classified.invariants: event_type and event_state are whitelisted (409); a cited source must exist (404) and belong to the same candidate (409); metadata criterion_key must exist in the published protocol
classified.side_effects: a completed phone_screen/interview/feedback with questions or feedback auto-publishes a structured Source and a MaterialRevision inside the same transaction

classified.request: any of metadata, event_state, outcome, notes, scheduled_at, duration_minutes, interviewer, location, actor
classified.concurrency: none observed - no If-Match; two clients editing the same event race last-write-wins
classified.invariants: event_state whitelisted; a completed structured event keeps its cited Source in agreement with the event text
classified.side_effects: when the structured text changes, publishes a new Source with supersedes_source_id and a new MaterialRevision; the old Source and revision stay immutable; identical text is idempotent and publishes nothing

classified.concurrency: state-based lock: a submitted scorecard cannot be overwritten by the same evaluator (409); no revision token across evaluators
classified.human_actor: yes - the evaluator is the human author and is recorded on the audit event
classified.invariants: feedback must be a non-empty array of validated entries; each evaluator keeps an independent scorecard
classified.side_effects: upserts one scorecard row per (event, evaluator)

classified.concurrency: none - status comparison only; cancelling a succeeded task is a reported no-op
classified.audit: none written by this route (task state only)
classified.human_actor: implicit - anyone able to reach the local Core
classified.invariants: unknown task 404; succeeded task returns its actual status instead of mutating
classified.side_effects: sets cancel_requested, status=cancelled and cancels the linked JobEngine job

classified.concurrency: idempotency key task:{id}:retry:{attempt+1} prevents duplicate job creation per attempt
classified.invariants: unknown task 404; a cancelled task cannot be retried (409)
classified.side_effects: enqueues or requeues a job and resets task error/finish fields

classified.invariants: name is required (409); payload is coerced to an object
unknown template 404; payload must be an object (409)

classified.side_effects: deletes the template row; projects already created from it keep their own protocol

classified.concurrency: none - reads the newest draft or published revision
classified.invariants: unknown project 404; a project with no protocol cannot produce a template (409)
classified.side_effects: inserts one RoleTemplate carrying a copy of the protocol payload

classified.concurrency: none - edits the newest draft, no If-Match
classified.audit: recorded as protocol provenance {origin: template_apply, template_id, mode}
classified.invariants: unknown template/project 404 (template first); mode must be merge or replace (409); a draft is forked when none exists
classified.side_effects: creates or mutates a draft ProtocolRevision; published revisions are never touched
